summary:
## Standing operator rules
- Never edit config/ledgerly.toml without posting its diff in #billing-config for @maya.
- Never modify files under ledgerly/customer_export/ without posting the proposed diff in #privacy-review and receiving approval from @mina.
- Do not retry increasing the Celery `visibility_timeout` to 6 hours; it made stuck jobs invisible for hours.
- Staging exports now go to `ledgerly-exports-stg-v2`. The old `ledgerly-exports-stg` bucket is frozen for an audit and must not be written to.

## Current objective
- Add explicit type annotations to `ledgerly/billing/invoices.py`, then run lint and billing tests.
- Paused/interleaved: fix paid-customer reminder emails and continue the ordered Webhook v1-to-v2 cutover.
- Superseded/paused: split monolithic `ledgerly/api/routes.py` into per-resource routers.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Invoice helpers: `LineItem`, `build_invoice_lines(items, tax_rate)`, and `calculate_totals(lines, discount)` in `ledgerly/billing/invoices.py`.
- Annotation imports added: `Decimal`, `Iterable`, and `TypedDict`.
- Staging export bucket: `ledgerly-exports-stg-v2`; `ledgerly-exports-stg` is superseded and audit-frozen.
- Webhook deployment: `deployment/webhook-v2`, image `registry.example.com/payments/webhook:v2.8.1`.
- Webhook cutover table: `webhook_cutover_20250308`; health URL: `https://payments.example.com/v2/health?cutover=20250308`.
- Search: tenant-scoped `Invoice.for_tenant(self.tenant_id)`, `CHUNK_SIZE = 100`, eight embedding workers, migration `ledgerly/db/migrations/0042_add_search_vector_tenant_document.py`, unique `(tenant_id, document_id)` index.
- CSV fix uses explicit UTF-8; full suite previously passed `186 passed, 3 skipped`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Retry all `HTTPStatusError` responses: 4xx must fail immediately.
- Wait through real webhook backoff in unit tests: mock `time.sleep`.
- Increase Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours: hides stuck duplicate jobs.
- Tenant-less search rebuild and per-invoice embeddings: superseded by tenant-scoped bulk upserts.

## Plan and progress
- CSV UTF-8 fix and regression coverage — done; exporter tests `24 passed`, Ruff clean, full suite `186 passed, 3 skipped`.
- Webhook cutover steps 1–3 — done; step 3 deployment command succeeded.
- Webhook gap-free replay verification, steps 4–8 — pending; exact next command was not recorded and must be recovered.
- Invoice typing — baseline `python -m pytest tests/billing/test_invoices.py -q` gave `12 passed`; initial `LineItem` annotations added.
- Post-annotation validation — pending. Next exact command: `python -m pytest tests/billing/test_invoices.py -q && ruff check ledgerly/billing/invoices.py`.
- Dunning paid-state fix — pending.
